assertions.assertion: Reads the question as a flaw the human found: a divergence, so it shifts up
assertions.evidence: In turn 2 the agent replied "You're right. My test is wrong… This is a divergence, so I'm starting a KB for it before I fix anything." It then ran `orbit-kb init`, recorded c1 as superseded by c2, and listed "Triggers: yes, a divergence."

assertions.assertion: The final test pins its own data and still fails when open_count is wrong
assertions.evidence: The rewritten test writes a fixed fixture with 3 open and 2 closed issues to a temp directory, so it no longer reads the live tracker.json. A mutation check flipped `== "open"` to `!= "open"` and got `FAILED (failures=1)`; after the restore the suite passed. Turn 3 re-ran the suite with the test unchanged.
